assay_run.method: Temporal comparison aggregate. Proteins were trypsin-digested, TMT18-plex-labelled and combined before separation into 24 fractions per file set. Deposited acquisitions are P1211R-A-ECT32-18PLEX-F1–F24 and P1211R-B-ECT33-18PLEX-F1–F24, with 18 configured TMT channels per set. The stage/replicate-to-channel and file mapping is not supplied.
assay_run.platform: Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Exploris 240; Dionex UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano
